definitions.gloss: shoe polishing; the act of shining shoes; a shoeshiner
definitions.explanation: Cleaning and polishing shoes to make them shine, or the tools or person that does this.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{靴磨|くつみが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I polish my shoes every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{靴磨|くつみが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a shoeshine stand in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{靴磨|くつみが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Before the important interview, I carefully polished my shoes.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧ (shoes) + {磨|みが}き (polishing). Refers to the activity, the supplies, or the person who shines shoes. Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean 'to polish shoes'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴磨|くつみが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to polish shoes
- {靴磨|くつみが}き⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: a shoeshine kit
- {靴磨|くつみが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: shoe-polishing tools
